headline: Police SI beaten to death in Savar after intervening in assault
summary: Special Branch officer Md. Altab Hossain was killed by a mob of 20-25 people in Aminbazar, Savar, while trying to stop the beating of an elderly man.
details: A Sub-Inspector (SI) of the Police Special Branch, Md. Altab Hossain, 60, was beaten to death in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.
The incident occurred on Saturday night when the officer and his 26-year-old son, Ariful Islam, intervened to stop the assault of an elderly man.
A mob of 20-25 people attacked them using indigenous weapons, leading to the death of Altab Hossain.
His son, Ariful Islam, was seriously injured in the attack and has been admitted to a hospital for treatment.
caption:
A 60-year-old Police Special Branch officer was beaten to death by a mob in Savar after trying to stop the assault of an elderly man.

A Sub-Inspector (SI) of the Police Special Branch, Md. Altab Hossain, 60, was beaten to death in the Bordeshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.

The incident occurred on Saturday night when the officer and his 26-year-old son, Ariful Islam, intervened to stop the assault of an elderly man.

A mob of 20-25 people attacked them using indigenous weapons, leading to the death of Altab Hossain.

His son, Ariful Islam, was seriously injured in the attack and has been admitted to a hospital for treatment.

headline_marked: Gold prices [[drop by 2,216 taka per bhori]] in Bangladesh
headline: Gold prices drop by 2,216 taka per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announced price reductions across all gold categories effective from Sunday morning.
details: The price of gold in the domestic market has decreased on Sunday. The maximum price drop was 2,216 taka per bhori for high-quality 22-carat gold.
According to the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS), the price of 22-carat gold now stands at 235,146 taka per bhori.
The association stated that the domestic prices were adjusted following a decrease in the price of pure gold (Tejaswi gold).
Other categories also saw reductions: 21-carat gold dropped by 2,100 taka to 224,590 taka, and 18-carat gold fell by 1,750 taka to 192,864 taka.
Traditional gold prices decreased by 1,458 taka, bringing the price to 157,522 taka per bhori.
While gold prices fell, silver prices remained unchanged. 22-carat silver is currently priced at 5,132 taka per bhori.
BAJUS clarified that wages are determined based on the design of the jewelry, and VAT is already included in the sale price, meaning no separate VAT should be collected from customers.
caption:
Gold prices in Bangladesh just took a dip! 📉

Max drop of 2,216 taka per bhori.

The price of gold in the domestic market has decreased on Sunday. The maximum price drop was 2,216 taka per bhori for high-quality 22-carat gold.

According to the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS), the price of 22-carat gold now stands at 235,146 taka per bhori.

The association stated that the domestic prices were adjusted following a decrease in the price of pure gold (Tejaswi gold).

Other categories also saw reductions: 21-carat gold dropped by 2,100 taka to 224,590 taka, and 18-carat gold fell by 1,750 taka to 192,864 taka.

Traditional gold prices decreased by 1,458 taka, bringing the price to 157,522 taka per bhori.

While gold prices fell, silver prices remained unchanged. 22-carat silver is currently priced at 5,132 taka per bhori.

BAJUS clarified that wages are determined based on the design of the jewelry, and VAT is already included in the sale price, meaning no separate VAT should be collected from customers.
